name: Geohash
description: Encode coordinates as geohash, or decode a geohash and get useful info. Original Raycast extension by alrico88 (MIT); Tezbar Rust port by almatkai.

preferences.label: Close on Action
preferences.description: Close extension on action execution (Copy to Clipboard / Open in Browser)
preferences.name: closeOnAction

commands.name: encode-coordinates
commands.title: Encode as Geohash
commands.description: Enter a latitude and longitude and get that point's representation as a geohash for any precision

commands.name: decode-geohash
commands.title: Decode Geohash
commands.description: Enter a geohash and get insights such as the GeoJSON or WKT Polygon representation, centroid, neighbors, and more
